import sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref
pool = (1,2,3)
cands = []
for k in (2,3):
    for p in itertools.permutations(pool, k):
        cands.append(p)
print('candidate paths', len(cands))
zero = 0; checked = 0
for r in range(1, 5):
    for combo in itertools.combinations(range(len(cands)), r):
        paths = [(cands[i], 1) for i in combo]
        agg = ref.aggregate(paths, set())
        _l,_r,final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
        core = sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
        if not core: continue
        occ = ref.occurrences(final, core)
        checked += 1
        Z, marg = ref.brute(occ)
        if Z == 0:
            zero += 1
            if zero <= 3:
                print('ZERO', paths, core)
